detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX - Chainlist has SSRF via MCP SSE and streamable-http transport — SSRF Exploitation
id: apex-ssrf-edf70ed9
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects SSRF exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-45019. SSRF allows attackers to make server-side HTTP requests to internal infrastructure including cloud metadata endpoints, internal services, and localhost. Look for requests to RFC1918/link-local addresses via user-controlled URL parameters.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-45019
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/25
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1602
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  ssrf_metadata_endpoints:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '169.254.169.254'
      - 'metadata.google.internal'
      - '100.100.100.200'
      - 'fd00:ec2::254'
    sc-status:
      - 200
      - 301
      - 302
  ssrf_localhost_targets:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'http://localhost'
      - 'http://127.0.0.1'
      - 'http://[::1]'
      - 'file://'
      - 'gopher://'
      - 'dict://'
  ssrf_internal_ranges:
    cs-uri-query|re: '(?:10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d+\.\d+)'
  condition: ssrf_metadata_endpoints or ssrf_localhost_targets or ssrf_internal_ranges
falsepositives:
  - Security scanners performing SSRF vulnerability assessments
  - Internal monitoring tools that access metadata endpoints
  - Load balancer health checks to internal addresses
level: high
detection_pack.spl:
| comment "Chainlist has SSRF via MCP SSE and streamable-http transport | CVE-2026-45019 | APEX v184.0"

| comment "SSRF cloud metadata detection"
index=web OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval is_ssrf = if(match(uri_query, "169\.254\.169\.254|metadata\.google\.internal|100\.100\.100\.200"), 1, 0)
| where is_ssrf=1
index=network OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval threat_match = if(match(_raw, "(?i)(CVE\-2026\-45019)"), 1, 0)
| where threat_match=1
| eval rule="APEX-CVE-2026-45019", severity="HIGH"
| stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_host, rule, severity
| convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort -count
detection_pack.yara:
rule APEX_CVE_2026_45019__SSRF {
    meta:
        description   = "APEX detection: Chainlist has SSRF via MCP SSE and streamable-http transports that all"
        cve           = "CVE-2026-45019"
        vuln_class    = "SSRF"
        author        = "CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0"
        date          = "2026-10-25"
        reference     = "https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com"
        severity      = "high"
        mitre_attack  = "T1190"
    strings:
        $ssrf_metadata = "169.254.169.254" ascii wide nocase  // SSRF cloud metadata endpoint
        $ssrf_gcp = "metadata.google.internal" ascii wide nocase  // SSRF GCP metadata
        $ssrf_loopback = "http://localhost" ascii wide nocase  // SSRF localhost target
        $ssrf_scheme = "gopher://" ascii wide nocase  // SSRF gopher scheme
    condition:
        2 of them
}

(

       last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
| sort - hits
retro_hunt.qradar_aql:
/* RETRO-HUNT AQL: intel--05596d1ad1308fc30b230068 | Lookback: 90d */
SELECT
    DATEFORMAT(devicetime,'YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EventTime,
    sourceip, destinationip, destinationhostname,
    username, "Application", "Event Category",
    LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS LogSource,
    QIDNAME(qid) AS EventName,
    'intel--05596d1ad1308fc30b230068' AS HuntAdvisoryID
FROM events
WHERE (
    destinationip IN ('<ip>')
    OR sourceip IN ('<ip>')
    OR destinationhostname IN ('<domain>')
    OR LOOKUPHOSTNAME(destinationip) IN ('<domain>')
)
AND devicetime > (NOW() - 7776000)
ORDER BY devicetime DESC
LIMIT 10000
START '90d ago'
STOP 'now'

retro_hunt.generic_sql:
/* RETRO-HUNT Generic SQL: intel--05596d1ad1308fc30b230068 | Lookback: 90d */
/* Compatible with: Splunk Data Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Data Explorer */
SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    host_name,
    source_ip,
    destination_ip,
    destination_domain,
    file_hash_sha256,
    process_name,
    process_command_line,
    user_name,
    'intel--05596d1ad1308fc30b230068' AS hunt_advisory_id
FROM security_events
WHERE event_timestamp > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND (
    destination_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR source_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR destination_domain IN ('<domain>')
    OR file_hash_sha256 IN ('<hash>')
  )
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50000;
